description: FDA compliance and enforcement actions taken against a firm — warning letters, injunctions, seizures, debarments — with the action type and the date taken. Search by firm, country, state, product type or date range. Source: FDA Data Dashboard (OII).

_apiKey.description: FDA Data Dashboard credential as "email:key" — the e-mail the credential was issued to, then the FDA-generated key, joined by a colon.

state.description: US state, as a postal code ("NJ") or full name ("New Jersey") — both work. Foreign sites carry no state; filter those by country.
